notes.title: We're back!
notes.content:
Hi guys, Paul Johnson here from Rubicon.

Following the demise of our publisher, GBWG has been off the store for quite some time now. However, Valve have graciously allowed us to take over the reigns on Steam, so here we are. And a nice place it is to be!

Now that there's someone in charge who actually cares about this game, we'll be happy to field questions, take suggestions and generally provide (we hope) some good quality customer support...
